rebuttal_or_critique: While I acknowledge the arguments of Dr. Goyal and Prof. Varma regarding the moderation in core inflation to 4.10%, I must emphasize that headline CPI at 5.55% remains uncomfortably close to the upper tolerance threshold. The persistent food inflation at 8.70%, compounded by the 6.0% monsoon deficit, poses a significant risk to the durability of the disinflation process. A shift to a neutral stance at this juncture could be misconstrued as a premature easing of our resolve, potentially unanchoring inflation expectations. Given the positive output gap of 0.60%, the economy retains sufficient momentum to withstand the current policy stance. Therefore, maintaining the withdrawal of accommodation is essential to ensure that inflation aligns durably with our 4.00% target.
